mandate_api.title: Nine-company product/program research batch - v0.3
mandate_api.thesis_text:
Research batch: nine NEW source-backed company/founder cases, graphs and genuine research recommendations. Source planning/investment-thesis/scouting-mandate.md v0.3. Human qualification remains separate. Legacy target_count is only a required compatibility field, not this batch completion metric.

Seek early-stage teams turning a costly bottleneck in care delivery, biological research, or disease treatment into a repeatable product, research platform, or therapeutic asset. Prioritize specific founder insight, attributable technical or experimental execution, and evidence that the approach improves on a relevant alternative. The initial opportunity must have a credible route to adoption or development, and the next milestone must resolve a material uncertainty.

cases.saved_next_action: Inspect one attributable Ledger claim-to-reconciliation workflow with its builder and clarify which submissions require human approval.
cases.saved_decisive_doubt: Can an identified builder demonstrate the claimed billing workflow, including the actual approval policy, rather than only describe it?
saved_execution_limits: No remaining research calls or permitted capabilities are supplied; the useful artifact check is proposed but execution is paused.
This is a reference comparison, not an authoritative qualification or rejection.

cases.saved_next_action: Inspect an authorized current referral-workflow walkthrough or deployment record, attribute its implementation, and clarify the advertised reduction metric.
cases.saved_decisive_doubt: Static screenshots and a historical deployment report do not yet establish a current attributable working workflow; the advertised reduction claim also lacks an interpretable method.
saved_execution_limits: No research calls remain and no retrieval capabilities are supplied; the useful investigation is proposed, not executed.
The policy permits reference comparison only, not authoritative qualification or rejection.

cases.saved_decisive_doubt: The actual workflow has not been inspected, so differentiated functionality and a repeatable core remain unestablished despite reported internal use.
saved_execution_limits: No research capabilities or remaining calls are available in this packet; execution of the useful inspection is paused. No investigation tool call is proposed.

The original-study link failed in the supplied research; an accessible alternative would be needed.
This is reference comparison, not an authoritative qualification or rejection.

cases.saved_decisive_doubt: No program-linked biological experiment was inspected. The computational artifact does not establish that a nominated target produces a therapeutically relevant effect.

Private materials have not been accessed; any request requires an authorized, human-reviewed channel.
